name: Purple Stuff

features.text: High-foaming cleaner that cleans concrete and degreases non-aluminum engines.
An excellent all-around cleaner when diluted properly.
Reduces the number of products needed in a shop.

description: A hot-type degreaser and floor cleaner well-suited for the toughest jobs. It works well on engines, tires, and floors.
application: Directions: Test product on an inconspicuous area for compatibility before using on entire surface. Avoid prolonged contact with aluminum, magnesium and painted surfaces. Can cause spotting or damage. Dilution: Always dilute with at least 12 parts water to 1 part product. 1) Use only in diluted form. 2) Spray or wipe diluted solution onto surface to be cleaned. 3) If needed, scrub surface with a brush or mop. Do not allow product to dry on surface. 4) Rinse surface thoroughly with water.
review: Spelling corrected from the old sheet: Biodegradeable -> Biodegradable
